description: This file defines a Java interface named FloatingRatesReadPlatformService which declares methods for retrieving floating rate data and interest rate periods within the Fineract financial system.

classes.name: FloatingRatesReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for reading floating rate related data in the system.

methods.name: retrieveLookupActive
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active floating rates for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific floating rate by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRatePeriods
methods.description: Retrieves interest rate periods for a given product ID.
